explanation: The statement is about the library-local definition `placesOf` (a Finset of `HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 ℚ)` built from `Ideal.finite_factors` of the span of a rational prime), which is defined in this same file and has no counterpart in Mathlib (grep for `placesOf` in Mathlib returns nothing). The proof applies only the library's own `disjoint_placesOf_of_coprime` via `Finset.disjoint_left` (that Mathlib lemma is pure order-theoretic glue about disjointness of Finsets currently, not the mathematical content here — Mathlib has no result about coprimality of integers and this set of height-one primes). Hence there is no Mathlib declaration stating this result or from which it follows in one or two lines.
